_comment: Models EvenUCan offers in its Local AI selector. Download URLs and SHA-256 checksums must be checked before a release: set sha256 to the file's real hash to have every download verified (null skips the check).

models.name: qwen2.5-coder:1.5b
models.title: Qwen2.5 Coder 1.5B (small and fast, default)
models.note: Good for ESPHome YAML and short Arduino sketches on a modest computer.

models.name: qwen2.5-coder:3b
models.title: Qwen2.5 Coder 3B (better code, needs more memory)
models.note: Better sketches and wiring answers. Needs about 4 GB of free memory.
